name: Atallah Happy Land Park
detail: Reported closed after ~39 years (announced on its official Instagram); ticket listing shows 'event ended'. Overture still lists stale points.

name: Abdul Raouf Khalil Museum
detail: Same complex as Al-Tayebat International City Museum (Arabic Wikipedia places the museum in Al-Tayebat City, Al-Faisaliyah). Kept once as slug al-tayebat-international-city-museum, status uncertain (no official site; operating status inferred from 2024-2026 press).

name: Bait Al-Hodaif
detail: Only source is a 2019 Arab News feature; not in OSM; Overture point uses a defunct Google business.site URL. Current operation and exact entrance not confirmable.

name: Le Mall (Tahlia)
detail: Not in OSM, no official website; Overture low-confidence point (21.5537, 39.1674); Malls.com profile 'pending'. A Commons caption mentions it but current status unknown.

name: Silver Sands Beach (Obhur)
detail: OSM node/502863852 'Silver Sands Private Beach Club' exists, but no official booking site could be reached/found; only third-party tour listings with unverified prices. Brief requires an official site for bookable beaches.

name: Other private Obhur beaches/resorts (Dream Beach, La Plage, Coral Beach, etc.)
detail: OSM/Overture entries exist but official sites were unreachable or absent; mostly members/day-pass resorts.

name: Jeddah open-air sculpture museum (Al-Hamra Corniche)
detail: Described as lying between Al-Anani Mosque and Al-Salam Palace on the Al-Hamra Corniche, but only a single Overture point (21.5334, 39.1578) gives a location and sculptures have been removed for maintenance at times. Not in OSM/Wikidata.

name: Xtreme Play (trampoline park)
detail: Official site (xtremeplay.sa) confirms a Jeddah trampoline park but gives no address; not in OSM; Overture-only coordinates.

name: Al-Haddad Scuba (Obhur)
detail: Official site live (haddadscuba.com) but no address found; not in OSM; Overture-only coordinates.

name: Other Obhur dive centres (Descent Dive Club, La Plage Diving Center, Blue Reef, Poseidon)
detail: Either official site unreachable (Descent) or OSM entry without any website (La Plage, way/623158565).

name: Bowling alleys / karting (Jeddah Lanes, In10so, The Track)
detail: No OSM entries found via Nominatim and no reachable official sites; Overture-only.

name: KidZania Jeddah
detail: Included with status=uncertain: official site behind bot check, no 2024-2026 news; Overture point inside Mall of Arabia.

name: Khuzam Palace / Jeddah Regional Museum
detail: Included with status=uncertain: no closure notice found but current public opening not confirmed.

name: North Corniche / Al-Hamra Corniche (as separate entries)
detail: North Corniche covered by jeddah-waterfront (ROSHN Waterfront); Al-Hamra Corniche covered by middle-corniche-park.

name: Large neighbourhood parks (Rawdah Park, Al-Ajwad Park, Al-Salamah parks)
detail: Exist in OSM (e.g. Rawdah Park way/53198139) but no independent source for facts/status; only Prince Majid Park included.

name: Art galleries (Athr Gallery, Hafez Gallery, Darat Safeya Binzagr)
detail: Not found in OSM via Nominatim; Overture-only coordinates.

name: Muvi Cinemas (Ar Ruwais) and other cinemas
detail: Brief asked for 3-5 cinemas; four best-documented kept (OSM node/14046790501 Muvi Ar Ruwais exists if more are wanted).
